claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Lumentum、它的供應商或客戶的一手文件寫出 Lumentum OCS 用的鏡陣列設計來自第三方（授權或整顆外購鏡陣列），或 Lumentum 停止 OCS 產品線。核查頻率：每季（Lumentum 10-Q／10-K 與法說；下一次 FY1Q27 財報 2026-11-05）。觸發後 48 小時：這條 develops 邊降 confidence 或提撤回，重讀 tech:mems_mirror_array 讀圖的設計方那一格與 Silex 敘事。
claims.statement: Lumentum blog 'MEMS Mirrors and the Evolution of Optical Switching in AI Data Centers' (Sheldon McLaughlin, 2026-05-28): Lumentum began developing MEMS-based optical switches in the late 1990s; 'Lumentum has applied this extensive experience in high-reliability MEMS mirror design and scalable optical subassembly manufacturing to MEMS-based Optical Circuit Switches for AI data centers'. Issuer self-report — a develops (design) edge, not supply; where the mirror wafers are fabricated is not stated.

source_doc.permission_basis: Lumentum 官網公開部落格（lumentum.com Blog）；只保留研究必要的有限逐字節錄（原頁 HTML 本機抽字、空白正規化）。published_at 取頁面日期「May 28, 2026」（頁面 metadata 2026-05-28）。公司部落格＝自述，比照 NVIDIA 部落格 news／tier 2 前例。
source_doc.title: Lumentum 部落格〈MEMS Mirrors and the Evolution of Optical Switching in AI Data Centers〉（Sheldon McLaughlin，2026-05-28）：「high-reliability MEMS mirror design」用到 AI 資料中心 OCS

sources.locator: 部落格正文〈Proven in Optical Networks〉第一段
sources.quote: Lumentum began developing MEMS-based optical switches in the late 1990s, and Lumentum MEMS-based 1xN Wavelength Selective Switches (WSS) have been widely deployed in telecom ROADM networks since the mid-2000s.

sources.locator: 部落格正文〈Proven in Optical Networks〉第二段
sources.quote: After more than two decades of WSS market leadership, Lumentum has applied this extensive experience in high-reliability MEMS mirror design and scalable optical subassembly manufacturing to MEMS-based Optical Circuit Switches for AI data centers.
